properties.description:
MAKE SAFE TO REPAIR DECK AT THE REAR TO ADDRESS CASE FILE CF-2023-080661 AS PER APPLICATION/PLANS AND IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE 2018 IRC. SEPARATE PERMITS REQUIRED FOR ALL OTHER WORK.  
Professional Engineer to serve as the design professional in responsible charge pursuant to Administrative Code Section A-304, and maintain, at a minimum, the following responsibilities:
1)	Immediately assess the structure to determine the extent of the structural defects and submit those findings along with a timeline of corrective actions to the Department.
2)	Design and observe the immediate installation of temporary protections of the public way and adjacent properties.
3)	Develop a remediation plan, detailing the extent of the required removal and replacement of structural components and temporary shoring required for the remediation. The remediation plan must contain adequate construction details to confirm code compliance as well as provide the responsible contractor with necessary direction in approaching and completing the necessary repairs. 
4)Submit such remediation plan with details to the Department along with an application for a building permit.
5)Provide periodic structural observations of the remediation work throughout the repair process.
6)Inform the Department if a condition arises which poses an immediate threat to public safety.
7)Upon completion of the repairs, submit a sealed statement to the Department that the structure has been made safe.
8)Inform the Department if oversight responsibilities are terminated by the owner.

**SCOPE OF WORK INCLUDES UNDERPINNING**

**Amendment Dated 07/06/2023 for revisions to core areas to facilitate an additional service elevator, add additional storage room to Level P1, rising curtain wall details at Cuthbert Street entrance facade, removing revolving door at N 33RD ST entrance, revising restroom facilities at Level P0, added ramp to vacant retail tenant space.**
**Amendment Dated 1/3/2023 for approval of temporary shoring and support of excavation**
For the erection of the core and shell for a new, twelve (12) story detached high-rise structure (w/terraces and green roof), to be used as Groups A-3/B/S-2 at 0th/1st Floors (Lobbies, accessory storage and offices), Groups A-3/B (Terraces and Vacant Office Space) at the 2nd through 9th & 11th floors (separate use registration and/or fit-out/CO permit(s) required prior to occupancy) Group S-2 @ 10th Floor (Mechanical space only), and Group S-2 (parking garage and accessory storage) within the basement, as per plans; separate permits required for all MEP/FSP work; building to be fully sprinklered throughout in accordance with NFPA 13, with standpipes installed within the exit stairways in accordance with NFPA 14, and a fire alarm system installed in accordance with NFPA 72; emergency responder radio coverage required as per 2018 PFC Section F-510.1; providing stairway pressurization as per 2018 IBC Section 909.20.5; if field conditions vary, contact design engineer prior to the start of any work; covered walkway or sidewalk closure shall be required within seventy-six (76) feet of the building facade in accordance with Section 3306 in the 2018 IBC (separate building and/or Streets Department permit required prior to start of any work); a site safety plan shall be submitted to the building inspector prior to the start of any construction; see ZP-2022-002438 for zoning/use approval; see SR-2022-013728 for work within the public right-of-way; no classes for students above the 12th grade as per applicant's letter dated 9/6/2022.
